name: safepay-frontend

scripts.test:recovery: tsc src/ts/services/pendingPayment.ts --target ES2022 --module commonjs --lib ES2022,DOM --strict --skipLibCheck --noEmitOnError --outDir .test-build && node --test tests/pendingPayment.test.cjs
scripts.test:contracts: tsc src/ts/services/wireCodec.ts src/ts/services/apiClient.ts src/ts/services/accountService.ts src/ts/services/beneficiaryService.ts src/ts/utils/paymentState.ts --target ES2022 --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --lib ES2022,DOM --strict --skipLibCheck --noEmitOnError --outDir .test-build/contracts && node --test tests/contracts.test.cjs
scripts.test: npm run test:recovery && npm run test:setup && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:ui && npm run test:evidence
